networkSubtitle: Connect your servers. Shape the route.
demo: Simulation mode • no servers are changed
loginTitle: A clear view of every connection.
loginSubtitle: Your infrastructure, connected and in control.
requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
name: Name
serverAccessHint: Root access installs and manages tunnel services. Credentials stay encrypted in your vault.
noCredentials: Add a password or private key to the vault first.
trustHint: Compare this fingerprint with your provider console or a trusted source before accepting it.
deleteServerHint: Remove this server and its connections? A deployment will clean up its managed tunnel resources.
emptyHint: Add your first servers, then draw a connection between them.
dragHint: Drag to arrange · connect the handles · click a line to configure
selectionHint: Hold Shift to select several servers.
unencrypted: Transport is not encrypted. Use application-level encryption.
removeConnectionHint: Remove this connection and clean up its managed resources?
deploymentHint: Saving immediately queues a deployment. Previous configuration is restored if checks fail.
poolHint: Connections sharing an entry port form one pool. Use the same distribution policy.
vaultSubtitle: Reuse credentials across servers. Secrets are encrypted and never returned.
deleteCredentialHint: Delete this credential? Credentials in use cannot be deleted.
cleanupHint: Disable every connection and remove all managed tunnel services, interfaces, and firewall rules? Shared packages and your application services are preserved.
keyOnce: Copy this key now. It will not be shown again.
keyHint: Send Authorization: Bearer <key> to /api/v1. Never put a key in a URL.
planHint: Only managed resources are listed. Secret file contents are never shown.
noSelection: Select a connection to shape its route.
notMonitored: Last deployment status; not a continuous uptime monitor.
connectBatchHint: Select at least one entry and one exit. A connection editor will apply the same settings to each pair.
destinationRequired: Your destination service must already be running. Tunnel Manager installs tunnel infrastructure only.
serverChangedTrust: Changing the SSH endpoint requires a new fingerprint check.

caveats.private_tls: Pinned private TLS; this is not browser camouflage.
caveats.udp_required: Requires UDP. Salamander cannot overcome a blanket UDP block.

controlPortHint: Optional {{protocol}} port, such as 443. Must be free on the receiving server. Leave empty for an automatic port.
exclusionHint: Comma-separated ports or ranges inside the entry range. Remaining target offsets stay unchanged.
nativeRangeMode: Native kernel forwarding · compact range rules
expandedRangeMode: Individual transport listeners · app limit: {{max}} ports per connection
mappingPlatform: Supported hosts: Debian / Ubuntu, systemd, IPv4. Application mappings: TCP.
invalidRange: Enter a port or an ascending range from 1 to 65535, for example 8000-8099.
rangeWidth: Entry and target ranges must contain the same number of ports.
invalidExclusions: Exceptions must be inside the entry range, without duplicates or overlaps (maximum 128 items).
emptyMapping: At least one port must remain after exceptions.
mappingOverlap: Mapping rows overlap. Split the ranges or add explicit exceptions.
mappingSshConflict: This range includes the entry server’s SSH port. Exclude it to preserve access.
mappingLimit: This method supports up to {{max}} mapped ports per connection in this app. Reduce the range or select another method.
actualPortConflicts: No blanket reserved port range. Topology conflicts are checked on save; live server listeners are checked before deployment.
nativePoolHint: Native GRE ranges must be exclusive on this entry. Shared-port load balancing is available for individual GRE ports and socket-based methods.
nativeHealthHint: Range health checks test the GRE peer, not every destination port. Closed application ports can remain in the range.
